description: This file defines the MigratePluginManager class, which manages migration plugins within Drupal's migration module. It includes constructor and createInstance methods for plugin management, referencing various Drupal core components and plugin attributes.

classes.name: MigratePluginManager
classes.description: Manages migration plugins for Drupal, extending DefaultPluginManager and implementing MigratePluginManagerInterface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new MigratePluginManager with specified plugin type, namespaces, cache backend, module handler, and optional attribute and annotation class names.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of a plugin by its ID, with optional configuration and migration context.
